description: white chocolate biscoff cookies 🤎    recipe:   ½ cup butter, softened (113g) ⅔ cup brown sugar, packed (133g) ⅓ cup granulated sugar (67g) 1 large egg (50g) 1 egg yolk (18g) 1 tsp vanilla extract (5g) 2 cups all-purpose flour (240g) 1 tbsp cornstarch (8g) ½ tsp baking soda (3g) ½ tsp salt (3g)  ¼ cup biscoff spread( used 2 tbsp for drizzle ) 6–8 biscoff cookies     cream butter & sugars until smooth, mix in eggs, biscoff & vanilla. fold in your dry ingredients until just combined then add in the white chocolate and biscoff cookies, & fold those in. scoop your dough balls ( i did 1 heaping tbsp for each cookie ) and place on a lined baking sheet. bake at 350•F for 10-12 minutes ( you’re looking for the edges to be set but the center soft, , if it still feels like dough leave it in but don’t over bake. if you’re unsure take the cookies out and let them cool if they’re still raw pop them back in. ) top with white chocolate biscoff & cookies.  ( if your cookies come out looking wonky shape them up with a big cup or cookie ring! )   #biscoff #cookies #Recipe #baking #fyp
